mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 50 degrees with overcast skies out near Badger Prairie County Park and a third quarter moon in the sky.

October is Community Planning Month, honoring the department that helps shape our city's future, and remember to keep an eye out for potential water survey letters in your mail to keep our supply clean.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow brings the Dane County Farmers' Market and music at Paddy Mac's.
Looking back at the reports, on September 21, a retail theft involving stolen candy was resolved after the offender was identified via surveillance video.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
